page.overview:
Who is Francisco Scaramanga?

Francisco Scaramanga is an apparent ally of Auric Goldfinger, who was secretly working for Ernst Stavro Blofeld. He appeared in the 2004 video game GoldenEye: Rogue Agent.

Francisco Scaramanga is an ally of Auric Goldfinger. He is the manufacturer of the synthetic eye given to GoldenEye and makes a virus used against Goldfinger's OMEN device. Although he seemingly worked alongside Goldfinger, it is later revealed that Scaramanga had been working with Ernst Stavro Blofeld, with the goal of manipulating the conflict between Goldfinger and Dr. No under they killed each other. Scaramanga met with Blofeld once Goldfinger and No were dead, as they discussed the potential threat that GoldenEye posed to them.
